input.title: [Desktop] HTML tag is extracted when user applies cmd+ctrl+E on a thought text with text color and formatting
input.body: ``` - Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet consectetur adipiscing elit. ``` ## Step to Reproduce: with Font Color 1. Apply Red Font Color onto the text 2. Select "Lorem ipsum" text 3. Click cmd+ctrl+E **Font Color** ## Step to Reproduce: with Background Color 1. Apply Red Font Color onto the text 2. Select "Lorem ipsum" text 3. Click cmd+ctrl+E **Background Color** ## Step to Reproduce: with Text Formatting 1. Apply Red Font Color onto the text 2. Select "Lorem ipsum" text 3. Click cmd+ctrl+E ## Current behavior HTML hardcode is extracted **Video:** **Text Color** https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a8a9df55-8a12-4df8-8587-300de495151b **Text Formatting** https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c3f78d2e-d39c-4dc5-8b30-3b93281386d2 ## Expected behavior This command should only extract the text
